A '''frosty treat''' was a dessert similar to ice-cream. [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]] was particularly fond of frosty treats.

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] ordered a frosty treat for Allana circa [[43 ABY]].
